title: 第七章临江城告急武曌的决心第8章家人的温暖玩死这帮发国难财的粮商
slug: 我最强毒士女帝直呼活阎王
lines: 这时，高阳和高峰也下了马车，推开了国公府大门。
高峰拉着一张脸，直接朝内宅走去。
高阳则是也朝着自已的房间走去。
定国公乃大乾六大国公之首，身份显赫，再加上高天龙宛如战神一般，一生罕有败绩，拿了不少赏赐。
高府内，简直大的吓人。
根据记忆，高阳绕过了几座假山，沿着长廊从外宅走到了内宅，最终到了自已的房间。
高阳直接往自已的床上扑了上去，干爽的褥子，简直令浑身每个细胞都发出贪婪的想要。
以一个最舒服的姿势躺在床上后，高阳心里开始盘算起来。
高家虽然在走下坡路，但毕竟瘦死的骆驼比马大，一门国公，一个三品大官，这身份足以令他在长安横着走。
现在，只需抱住女帝的大白腿，那他在长安的小日子，简直不敢想。
那叫一个舒服惬意。
“也不知女帝会赏一个什么职位的官……”
正当高阳胡思乱想着，房门猛然被推开。
一个扎着马尾辫，看起来约莫六七岁的小女孩映入眼帘。
小女孩脸蛋水灵灵的，眼睛乌溜溜的圆。
一见高阳，小女孩立刻哇哇大哭起来。
“呜呜呜。”
“哥，你怎么没死呢？”
高峰一路来到了内宅最中间的一个房间，他快步推开房间，然后恭敬的向高天龙行礼。
“孩儿拜见父亲大人。”
大乾以孝治国，晚辈见了长辈必须恭敬行礼。
高天龙面无表情，正在摆弄棋盘，“阳儿的事情，老夫都知道了。”
“这孽子藏的够深，但今日之事，不光对这孽子是一件好事，对我高家亦是一件好事。”
高峰却忧心忡忡，“可陛下却并未封赏，这就代表，眼下一切尚未尘埃落定啊！”
高天龙一边摆弄棋盘，一边道，“阳儿顽劣，声名远扬，原本这崔家崔星河已是女帝心中最好的人选，但半路却杀出了阳儿。”
“崔星河乃大乾状元，不仅精通经义，还深谙治国之道，陛下犹豫也十分正常，照老夫对陛下的了解，陛下在崔星河和阳儿之间，还有一道具体到治国的考核。”
“当今陛下的野心，可一点都不比先帝小。”
高峰眉头皱紧，“照父亲所说，阳儿若不能胜过那崔星河，岂不是依旧难逃责罚。”
“那倒未必。”
高峰眼前一亮，“父亲大人对阳儿有信心？”
高天龙点点头，一阵感慨。
“老夫火了快七十载，历经三帝，什么脏的计策没见过，但像这么毒辣的，还是第一次见。”
“阳儿，说不定会再给我们惊喜。”
高峰闻言，深有同感的点了点头。
“再说了，只要老夫还活着，总归能保他一命的，不说这些了，来下棋。”
高天龙指着棋盘说道。
高峰脸色一变，“父亲，你一个大乾棋子圣，欺负我这臭棋篓子，是不是不太好？”
高天龙摸着胡须，哈哈大笑，“算你小子会说话，老夫岂会欺负小辈，让你一子。”
高峰见躲不掉，只能硬着头皮坐下，但他忍不住的道，“父亲大人，咱们先说好，若是输琪，谁都不准拿棋盘打人。”
皇宫。
content_en:
At this time, Gao Yang and Gao Feng also got off the carriage and opened the door of the Duke's Mansion.
Gao Feng pulled a straight face and walked directly towards the inner house.
Gao Yang also walked towards his room.
Duke Ding was the leader of the six great Dukes of Daqian and had a prominent status. In addition, Gao Tianlong was like a god of war. He rarely failed in his life and received many rewards.
Inside the Gao Mansion, it was simply terrifying.
According to his memory, Gao Yang walked around several rockeries, walked along the corridor from the outer house to the inner house, and finally arrived at his room.
Gao Yang jumped directly onto his bed. The dry mattress made every cell in his body feel greedy.
"It's cool!"
After lying on the bed in the most comfortable position, Gao Yang began to make plans in his mind.
Although the Gao family was in decline, after all, a skinny camel was bigger than a horse. He was a Duke of the country and a third-rank official. This status was enough for him to walk sideways in Chang'an.
Now, all he had to do was hold the empress's big white legs, and he couldn't even imagine his little life in Chang'an.
That's called comfort.
"I don't know what position the empress will reward an official..."
Just as Gao Yang was thinking wildly, the door was suddenly pushed open.
A little girl with a ponytail who looked about six or seven years old came into view.
The little girl has a juicy face and dark round eyes.
As soon as she saw Gao Yang, the little girl burst into tears.
"Uuuuuuuuuuuuuuuuu"
"Brother, why are you not dead?"
"..."
Gao Feng walked all the way to the middle room of the inner house. He quickly pushed open the room and saluted Gao Tianlong respectfully.
"My child pays homage to my father."
Daqian governs the country with filial piety, and juniors must bow respectfully when meeting their elders.
Gao Tianlong was expressionless as he was playing with the chessboard, "I already know everything about Yang'er."
"This evil boy has hidden deep enough, but what happened today is not only a good thing for this evil boy, but also a good thing for my Gao family."
Gao Feng was worried, "But His Majesty did not award the reward, which means that everything has not been settled yet!"
While playing with the chessboard, Gao Tianlong said, "Yang'er has a reputation for being naughty and naughty. Originally, Cui Xinghe of the Cui family was already the best candidate for the empress, but Yang'er was killed halfway."
"Cui Xinghe is the number one scholar of the Great Qian Dynasty. He is not only proficient in classics and meanings, but also knows how to govern the country. It is normal for Your Majesty to hesitate. According to my understanding of Your Majesty, between Cui Xinghe and Yang'er, Your Majesty has another specific assessment related to governing the country."
"Your Majesty's ambition today is no less ambitious than that of the late Emperor."
Gao Feng frowned, "According to what father said, if Yang'er can't defeat Cui Xinghe, won't he still be unable to escape punishment?"
"That's not necessarily the case."
Gao Feng's eyes lit up, "Father, do you have confidence in Yang'er?"
Gao Tianlong nodded, sighing with emotion.
"I have been popular for almost seventy years. After three emperors, I have never seen any dirty tricks, but this is the first time I have seen such a vicious one."
"Yang'er, maybe you will surprise us again."
Hearing this, Gao Feng nodded sympathetically.
"Besides, as long as I'm still alive, I can save his life. Let's not talk about this anymore and let's play chess."
Gao Tianlong pointed at the chessboard and said.
Gao Feng's expression changed, "Father, isn't it bad for you, a great chess player, to bully a bad chess player like me?"
Gao Tianlong stroked his beard and laughed, "You know how to talk, how could I bully a junior and give you a child?"
Seeing that he couldn't escape, Gao Feng had no choice but to sit down, but he couldn't help but said, "Father, let's make an agreement first. If we lose Qi, no one is allowed to hit anyone with the chessboard."
"..."
royal palace.
